name: Boston College
meets_full_need_notes: Boston College meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted domestic undergraduates. The university has a strong commitment to affordability for middle-income families.
no_loan_notes: Boston College does not have a no-loan policy. Federal loans are included in most aid packages, though the university has reduced loan burdens for low-income students.
ed_aid_implications: Boston College offers both Early Decision (binding) and Early Action (non-binding). Financial aid packages are identical regardless of application plan. Students should run the Net Price Calculator before applying ED.
special_programs: Boston College Financial Aid Initiative (need-based grants)
Full Tuition Scholarships (highly competitive, full-need based)
appeal_policy: Boston College students may appeal their financial aid package through the Office of Student Services by submitting a Special Circumstances Appeal with supporting documentation.
